name: Wolfsberg CBDDQ — Correspondent Banking Due Diligence Questionnaire

articles.title: Entity identification
articles.requirement: Full legal name, jurisdiction, regulatory status, ownership structure, publicly traded status

articles.title: Business activities
articles.requirement: Description of all products/services; customer segments; geographic footprint; business lines

articles.title: AML/CFT programme — foundation
articles.requirement: Documented AML/CFT policy approved by senior management; MLRO designation; programme adequacy

articles.title: AML/CFT programme — governance
articles.requirement: Board-level oversight; AML committee structure; annual AML risk review; programme testing

articles.title: AML/CFT programme — risk assessment
articles.requirement: Enterprise-wide ML/TF risk assessment; customer, product, channel, geography risk factors; documented

articles.title: Customer due diligence
articles.requirement: CDD programme covering onboarding, customer identification, verification, beneficial ownership, risk rating

articles.title: Customer risk rating
articles.requirement: Documented customer risk rating methodology; factors considered; high-risk escalation procedures

articles.title: PEP controls
articles.requirement: PEP identification; enhanced due diligence; senior management approval; ongoing monitoring

articles.title: Transaction monitoring
articles.requirement: TM system in place; scenario-based and/or rules-based; alert investigation procedures; tuning process

articles.title: Suspicious activity reporting
articles.requirement: SAR/STR process; MLRO review; FIU reporting; tipping-off controls; documentation retention

articles.title: Sanctions
articles.requirement: Sanctions screening programme; list sources (OFAC, EU, UN, OFSI); real-time screening; match resolution

articles.title: Training
articles.requirement: AML/CFT training programme; role-specific training; frequency; tracking and attestation

articles.title: Correspondent banking — specific controls
articles.requirement: SWIFT/payments controls; nested account controls; payable-through account controls; de-risking policy

articles.title: Audit and testing
articles.requirement: Independent AML/CFT programme testing; audit findings remediation; regulat exam experience
